# RDS Data API

Execute SQL through the AWS Data API against local Aurora Docker engines.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `rdsdata` |
| Signing name | `rds-data` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2018-08-01` |
| Scope | Account and region |
| Execution | Optional Docker |
| Selected operations | 5 of 6 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#rds-data-api) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Requires rds.instances: docker for SQL execution; no SQL interpreter or canned results in records mode.
- Array parameters/results, resultSetOptions, continueAfterTimeout, cancellation and asynchronous execution are unsupported; unimplemented input members fail explicitly.
- Cluster credentials are validated locally; IAM database authentication, AWS connection management, network failover and distributed transactions are not emulated.
- Column metadata reflects database/sql driver information; table/schema provenance and auto-increment metadata are unavailable; operations are serialized within the Data API service.
- Transactions and SQL connection state are not persisted across TinyStack restarts.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

## Supported operations

The table is generated from the profile and pinned Smithy model. Routes show REST bindings or the standard
JSON/Query endpoint. RPC v2 CBOR uses its service/operation route, as described in
[protocol handling](../architecture/request-flow.md). Supported members are selected separately in the
[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.

| Operation | HTTP binding |
| --- | --- |
| `BatchExecuteStatement` | `POST /BatchExecute` |
| `BeginTransaction` | `POST /BeginTransaction` |
| `CommitTransaction` | `POST /CommitTransaction` |
| `ExecuteStatement` | `POST /Execute` |
| `RollbackTransaction` | `POST /RollbackTransaction` |
